name: What factors determine a good long-term rental investment property?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine a good long-term rental investment property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Key factors include location, property type, potential rental income, operating expenses, and market demand. Properties near amenities, employment centers, or desirable school districts often attract tenants. In areas Kelby Contreras serves, like Miami-Dade and Broward Counties, properties with strong tourist appeal or consistent job growth can offer robust rental demand. We can help assess these factors to align with your investment goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Good long-term rental investments depend on location, potential income, expenses, and market demand, with strong rental appeal in areas like Miami-Dade and Broward.
